record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.context_brief: Pair correlations for quadratic Kronecker sequences
record.original_question: If α∈R is badly approximable by rationals, does the pair correlation R_2([a,b],N,α) for the sequence αn^2 mod 1 converge to b−a as N→∞?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 21 (Z. Rudnick, P . Sarnak). If α ∈ R is badly approximable by ratio-nals (see [218] for exact conditions), then (1) R2([a, b], N , α) → b − a as N → ∞ .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a real number α and a positive integer N, define the (normalized) pair correlation function of the sequence (αn² mod 1)_{n=1}^{N} on an interval [a,b] ⊂ ℝ by
   R_2([a,b], N, α) := (1/N) · #{ 1 ≤ m ≠ n ≤ N : αn² − αm² ∈ (1/N)·[a,b] + ℤ }.
A real number α is called badly approximable (by rationals) if there exists a constant c > 0 such that |α − p/q| > c/q² for every rational p/q.

Question: Is it true that for every badly approximable α ∈ ℝ and every a < b in ℝ,
   R_2([a,b], N, α) → b − a as N → ∞ ?
artifact.category_tag: Pair correlations of quadratic sequences mod 1
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture of Rudnick–Sarnak that αn² mod 1 has Poissonian pair correlation for suitably Diophantine α remains open. Rudnick and Sarnak (1998) established the result for almost every α, and subsequent work by Heath-Brown, Truelsen, Marklof–Yesha and others gives partial results under stronger Diophantine conditions, but no specific badly approximable α is known to satisfy the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The Pair Correlation Function of Fractional Parts of Polynomials (Rudnick–Sarnak)
status_evidence.snippet: Rudnick and Sarnak proved Poissonian pair correlation for αn^d for almost every α, conjecturing it under Diophantine hypotheses; no explicit α is known.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is established only for almost every α, not for specific badly approximable α.

status_evidence.title: Pair correlation for fractional parts of αn² (Heath-Brown)
status_evidence.snippet: Heath-Brown strengthened the almost-everywhere result under Diophantine conditions on the convergents of α.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress under stronger Diophantine conditions, but conjecture for general badly approximable α remains open.

status_evidence.title: Divisor problems and the pair correlation for the fractional parts of n²α (Truelsen)
status_evidence.snippet: Truelsen establishes pair correlation under a divisor-type hypothesis on denominators of convergents.
status_evidence.claim: Conditional results exist but the general conjecture is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Pair correlation for quadratic polynomials mod 1 (Marklof–Yesha)
status_evidence.snippet: Marklof and Yesha obtain pair-correlation results under Diophantine assumptions stronger than bad approximability.
status_evidence.claim: No proof for arbitrary badly approximable α is known.
